shared_context.content: For a real number x, floor(x) denotes the integer floor Int.floor x; when it appears in real arithmetic, it is coerced to a real number.
shared_context.label: floor_notation

shared_context.content: For a real number x, frac(x) denotes the real fractional part Real.frac x.
shared_context.label: frac_notation

strategy_summary: Prove the theorem by separating it into an equality part and an interval-bounds part. First unfold the fractional part as x - floor(x), then use standard floor inequalities to control that difference. Finally rewrite the difference back as frac(x) and combine the three resulting statements.
